source_scope: Iterates of a fixed balanced regular b-input Boolean gate with equal input influences alpha=mu/b and 1<mu<b.

claims.statement: One normalized hybrid reference that uses true spectral child branching at retained physical heights and occurrence-reference branching elsewhere yields a single variational KL lower certificate; its loss is the exact sum of omitted source-weighted conditional branch divergences.
claims.full_fei_implication: Conditional family mechanism only; arbitrary prime gates need not have the physical hierarchy.

claims.statement: For each fixed regular balanced generator and epsilon in (0,1], O_g(log m+log(1/epsilon)) retained physical hierarchy heights recover K_occ to additive epsilon I at every depth m. Explicit finite-depth remainder and bottom/top cutoffs are given.
claims.full_fei_implication: No full FEI conclusion; provides coefficient-one KL recovery up to prescribed additive influence scale on the stated actual Boolean family.

claims.statement: On recursive ternary majority of depth m, retaining bottom min(m,ceil(log_(3/2)(4(m+1)))) heights yields a normalized variational credit at least Hmax-6(I-1) for every m.
claims.full_fei_implication: Center6 is only the certified extraction threshold for this family; it is not a new universal FEI constant and this family already has H=4(I-1).

claims.statement: In the bottom-prefix/top-suffix hybrid architecture, if height L+1 is omitted, m>=16 and L<=m/(2log2(3)), the lost KL is at least mI/[8(3/2)^(L+1)]. Thus additive BI loss requires L>=log_(3/2)(m/(8B))-1.
claims.full_fei_implication: Architecture-specific necessity; not a lower bound for every possible variational statistic.
